2022-02: The biggest incident for Garland police in February 2022 was a manslaughter down in south-central Garland on Vista Drive. Aside from that, theft was the main issue with 215 cases, followed by 148 burglaries and 74 reports of criminal mischief. The busiest spots were up northwest by Belt Line and Jupiter, and out west around Walnut and Forest, which each saw 41 incidents.
